answer: Delayed, clawback-able vesting: each epoch's reward is planted like an orchard sapling and only vests after 90 days. Until then it sits on a ledge where any later sybil finding (shared funding, copied answers) lets auditors claw back the whole unvested pile and pay a bounty to the reporter. A farm must keep every key clean for months while its locked capital is exposed, so cracking this walnut costs far more than honest work earns.
